package.path='src/lua/?.lua;build/lua/?.lua;'..package.path
local RealCopy=require('abyss_copy')
local RealProfiles=require('abyss_character_profiles')
local RealRed=require('abyss_run_red_card_contract')
local D=require('abyss_data')
local files={'tests/fixtures/run-catalog-responsibilities-before.lua','src/lua/abyss_run_card_catalog.lua'}
local function sortedKeys(t)
 local keys={};for k in pairs(t)do keys[#keys+1]=k end
 table.sort(keys,function(a,b)if type(a)==type(b)then return a<b end;return type(a)<type(b)end)
 return keys
end
local function world(file,mode,character,owned,failAt,warmup)
 local events,backing,wrapped,names={},{},{},{}
 local marker={sentinel=true};local logging=false
 local function log(event)
  if not logging then return end
  events[#events+1]=event
  if failAt==#events then error(marker,0)end
 end
 local wrap
 wrap=function(t,path)
  if type(t)~='table'then return t end
  if backing[t]then return t end
  if wrapped[t]then return wrapped[t]end
  local proxy={};wrapped[t]=proxy;backing[proxy]=t;names[proxy]=path
  return setmetatable(proxy,{
   __index=function(_,key)log('get '..path..'.'..tostring(key));return wrap(t[key],path..'.'..tostring(key))end,
   __newindex=function(_,key,value)log('set '..path..'.'..tostring(key)..':'..type(value));t[key]=value end,
   __len=function()log('len '..path);return #t end,
   __pairs=function()
    log('pairs '..path);local keys=sortedKeys(t);local at=0
    return function()at=at+1;local key=keys[at];if key~=nil then log('iter '..path..'.'..tostring(key));return key,wrap(t[key],path..'.'..tostring(key))end end
   end,
   __metatable='independent catalog proxy',
  })
 end
 local source=RealCopy.copy(D)
 source.extension={};source.extension.self=source.extension
 source.cardListAlias=source.cards.cards;source.statusListAlias=source.statuses.statuses
 source.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata={};source.metaAlias=source.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata
 for _,c in ipairs(source.cards.cards)do if c.id=='strike'then source.strikeAlias=c;c.opaque=source.extension end end
 local selected=RealProfiles.prepare(RealCopy.copy(D),character)
 selected.extension={};selected.extension.self=selected.extension
 selected.cardListAlias=selected.cards.cards;selected.statusListAlias=selected.statuses.statuses
 selected.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata=selected.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata or {}
 selected.metaAlias=selected.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata
 source=wrap(source,'source');selected=wrap(selected,'selected')
 local calls={copy=0,prepare=0,isRed=0,matches=0}
 local copy,profiles,red={},{},{}
 local function depProxy(target,original)
  return setmetatable(target,{__index=function(_,key)
   log('dependency get '..key)
   return function(...)
    calls[key]=(calls[key]or 0)+1
    log('dependency call '..key..' #'..calls[key])
    return original[key](...)
   end
  end})
 end
 depProxy(copy,RealCopy);depProxy(profiles,RealProfiles);depProxy(red,RealRed)
 local env=setmetatable({require=function(name)
  if name=='abyss_copy'then return copy elseif name=='abyss_character_profiles'then return profiles elseif name=='abyss_run_red_card_contract'then return red end
  log('require '..name);return require(name)
 end},{__index=_G})
 local module=assert(loadfile(file,'t',env))()
 if warmup then module.prepareSelected(source,'ironclad')end
 logging=true
 local ok,out,profile
 if mode=='selected'then ok,out,profile=pcall(module.prepareSelected,source,character)
 else ok,out=pcall(module.prepare,source,selected,character,owned)end
 logging=false
 local function canonical(root)
  local seen,rows={},{}
  local function visit(v)
   if type(v)~='table'then return type(v)..':'..tostring(v)end
   v=backing[v]or v
   if seen[v]then return '@'..seen[v]end
   local id=#rows+1;seen[v]=id;rows[id]=''
   local row={}
   for _,key in ipairs(sortedKeys(v))do row[#row+1]=visit(key)..'='..visit(v[key])end
   rows[id]=table.concat(row,';');return '@'..id
  end
  visit(root);return table.concat(rows,'\n')
 end
 if ok then
  assert(out.cardListAlias==out.cards.cards and out.statusListAlias==out.statuses.statuses)
  assert(out.metaAlias==out.cards.sourcePools.cardSourceMetadata)
  assert(out.extension.self==out.extension)
  if mode=='prepare'then assert((out==selected)==owned)end
  if mode=='selected'then assert(out.strikeAlias.opaque==out.extension)end
 elseif failAt then assert(out==marker,'exception object identity was changed')
 else error('unexpected failure: '..tostring(out))end
 return {trace=events,ok=ok,out=ok and canonical(out)or 'sentinel',source=canonical(source),selected=canonical(selected),profile=canonical(profile)}
end
local cases={}
for _,character in ipairs({'ironclad','silent','defect','watcher'})do
 cases[#cases+1]={'selected',character,false}
 cases[#cases+1]={'prepare',character,false}
 cases[#cases+1]={'prepare',character,true}
end
local function equal(a,b,label)
 assert(a.ok==b.ok,label..' outcome')
 for _,key in ipairs({'out','source','selected','profile'})do assert(a[key]==b[key],label..' graph '..key)end
 assert(#a.trace==#b.trace,label..' trace count '..#a.trace..'/'..#b.trace)
 for i=1,#a.trace do assert(a.trace[i]==b.trace[i],label..' trace '..i..' '..a.trace[i]..' / '..b.trace[i])end
end
local total=0
for _,case in ipairs(cases)do
 local mode,character,owned=table.unpack(case);local label=mode..'/'..character..'/'..tostring(owned)
 local before=world(files[1],mode,character,owned);local after=world(files[2],mode,character,owned)
 equal(before,after,label);total=total+#before.trace
 print('PROXY_TRACE_PASS '..label..' events='..#before.trace)
 -- Representative early, mid and late dependency/metamethod failures. Retains
 -- exact exception object plus partial source/selected graph after each stop.
 local stops=(character=='silent'and owned)and {1,2,17,math.floor(#before.trace/2),#before.trace-2,#before.trace}or {}
 for _,at in ipairs(stops)do
  equal(world(files[1],mode,character,owned,at),world(files[2],mode,character,owned,at),label..' injected '..at)
 end
end
for _,mode in ipairs({'selected','prepare'})do
 local before=world(files[1],mode,'silent',true,nil,true)
 local after=world(files[2],mode,'silent',true,nil,true)
 equal(before,after,mode..'/warm');total=total+#before.trace
 print('PROXY_WARM_PASS '..mode..' events='..#before.trace)
end
print('INDEPENDENT_PROXY_PASS cases='..#cases..' failure-pairs=6'..' observed-events='..total)
